integrity: Original scientific derivations are distinguished from the established elementary-collapse factorization and classical all-clique coefficient/idempotent enumeration; computational checks do not replace the proof and no external mathematical audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the induced commuting graph of rank-(n-1) idempotents in the full transformation monoid is treated. The finite checker covers n<=7 for clique counts and n<=6 for exact spectrum; general assertions rely on the proof. The discriminant criterion characterizes integrality but the Lucas subfamily need not be an exhaustive parameterization of its integer solutions. Literature priority remains subject to further inspection.
title: Stirling-maximal cliques and Pell-type integral spectra of defect-one transformation idempotents
